title: Design System: Sundollar — Swipe to Save

display.purpose: Money figures (34px strong) and celebration titles (30px) only. Bricolage Grotesque 800, -0.02em.

headline.purpose: App greeting (27px, text-wrap: balance) and sheet titles (24px).

body.purpose: Explainers and secondary copy in Rubik; 13.5-15px, line-height 1.45, ink-soft.

label.purpose: Chips, links, stepper numbers, pill labels; Rubik 600-700, 13-14.5px.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Save card and docked teaser lift; sea-teal tinted, never gray. Dark theme: 0 18px 44px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 2px 10px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4).

shadows.name: shadow-thumb
shadows.purpose: Warm cast under the sun-disc swipe thumb and wordmark disc. Dark theme: 0 6px 16px -4px rgba(255,92,138,0.6).

shadows.name: shadow-sheet
shadows.purpose: Upward lift under the full-screen sheet. Dark theme: 0 -18px 52px -18px rgba(0,0,0,0.7).

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Guava-tinted pop reserved for the CTA pill. Dark theme: 0 24px 64px -18px rgba(255,92,138,0.5).

shadows.name: step-active-glow
shadows.purpose: Glow under the active (pulsing) stepper dot; color rides --step-active-bg.

motion.name: spring-sheet
motion.purpose: Full-screen sheet rising from the device bottom; scrim fades 0.22s.

motion.name: spring-pill-complete
motion.purpose: Swipe thumb snapping to the end on a completed swipe (>=82% travel).

motion.name: spring-pill-return
motion.purpose: Swipe thumb springing back on an abandoned drag.

motion.name: spring-celebration-body
motion.purpose: Celebration title popping in during the save takeover.

motion.name: check-draw
motion.purpose: Stepper checkmark drawn on completion (reactbits grammar).

motion.name: piggy-pop
motion.purpose: Finale piggy pop-in; coin drop follows at 0.55s delay.

motion.name: arrow-pulse
motion.purpose: Three chevrons on the swipe pill label; static at 0.7 opacity under reduced motion.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Screen and card backgrounds crossfading on theme toggle.

motion.name: celebration-hold
motion.purpose: How long takeovers stay before auto-dismissing to the next state.

motion.name: fx-durations
motion.purpose: Canvas effects self-terminate; skipped entirely under reduced motion.

components.name: CTA Pill
components.description: The loudest button: guava capsule filling the card's 64px action slot (intro and chain-done states) and the sheet footer.
components.html: <button class="ds-cta-pill">Start a goal <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m9 5.5 6.5 6.5L9 18.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-cta-pill { width: 100%; height: 64px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #f2336b; color: #2a0a18; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.005em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(242, 51, 107, 0.45); transition: transform 0.15s ease, filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-cta-pill:hover:enabled { filter: brightness(1.07); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta-pill:active:enabled { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-cta-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007d76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cta-pill:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Swipe Pill
components.description: The sacred gesture: 64px capsule track with a 52px radial sun-disc thumb dragged left to right; surf-to-sunshine fill trails the thumb.
components.html: Swipe to save $10
components.css: .ds-swipepill { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 340px; height: 64px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eaf6f1; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 52, 51, 0.12); overflow: hidden; } .ds-swipepill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007d76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swipepill-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 64px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 169, 159, 0.35), rgba(255, 197, 49, 0.65)); } .ds-swipepill-label { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #43655f; pointer-events: none; } .ds-swipepill-arrows { display: inline-flex; } .ds-swipepill-arrows svg { margin-left: -7px; animation: ds-arrow-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-swipepill-arrows svg:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; } .ds-swipepill-arrows svg:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; } @keyframes ds-arrow-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.25; } 40% { opacity: 1; } } .ds-swipepill-thumb { position: absolute; top: 5px; left: 6px; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #ffe082 0%, #ffb300 52%, #f26a1b 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -4px rgba(210, 84, 0, 0.55), inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(242, 106, 27, 0.45); color: rgba(46, 22, 3, 0.85); cursor: grab; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Preset option in an edge-bleeding swipe row; surf tint at rest, solid ink-lagoon when selected (aria-pressed).
components.css: .ds-chip { flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 48px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; background: rgba(0, 169, 159, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 169, 159, 0.32); color: #113231; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #00a99f; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007d76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #113231; border-color: #113231; color: #fffdf8; }

components.name: Link-Below
components.description: The DIY escape hatch under every chip row ('Add my own'); underlined surf-deep link with a 44px hit area.
components.css: .ds-linkbtn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 44px; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #007d76; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-linkbtn:hover { color: #113231; } .ds-linkbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007d76; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Save-chain step bar (reactbits grammar): done = surf dot with drawn check, active = pulsing guava dot with glow, upcoming = numbered ring; connectors fill in surf.
components.html: 45
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; max-width: 340px; } .ds-step-line { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 5px; margin: 0 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(18, 52, 51, 0.16); overflow: hidden; } .ds-step-line-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; background: #00a99f; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-step-dot { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #6c8a83; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px rgba(18, 52, 51, 0.22); background: transparent; } .ds-step-dot.ds-is-done { background: #00a99f; box-shadow: none; color: #ffffff; } .ds-step-dot.ds-is-active { background: #f2336b; box-shadow: 0 5px 16px -4px #f2336b; } .ds-step-pulse { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed 48px seafoam input with 14px radius; money variant carries a leading $ and shifts its border to surf on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" type="text" placeholder="Name your goal" aria-label="Custom goal name" />
components.css: .ds-field { height: 48px; width: 100%; max-width: 300px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(18, 52, 51, 0.14); background: #f2f7f2; color: #113231; font-family: 'Rubik Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #54736c; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007d76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #00a99f; }

components.name: Emoji Tile
components.description: 48px emoji picker tile; hover scales up, selection earns a 1.5px guava border over chip tint.
components.css: .ds-emojibtn { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 16px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 23px; background: #f2f7f2; border: 1.5px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-emojibtn:hover { transform: scale(1.08); } .ds-emojibtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #007d76; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-emojibtn[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #f2336b; background: rgba(0, 169, 159, 0.1); }

narrative.overview:
Sundollar is an invented, clearly synthetic bright-Floridian youth bank, and its world is one Florida day seen twice. In light mode ("Flamingo Daylight") the phone screen is open air — a sky-to-sand gradient with a warm sun-glow radial in the top-right corner — and content lives on a warm-white card floating in that air. In dark mode ("Neon Night Swim") the same screen becomes deep-ocean indigo with a guava glow rising from the bottom edge, and every accent re-inks to neon. The thesis: saving is one sun-bright thumb gesture chained into a visible streak; this world explicitly refuses the gray fintech dashboard-of-toggles.

Energy and saturation are features, not decoration — but numbers stay instantly legible: amounts and dates always render in high-contrast ink with tabular numerals. The interface is dense in the way a good phone widget is dense: one 482px card carries the entire product loop (invite → goal → swipe → streak → finale), and every state of that card shares one fixed five-slot geometry so the eye always knows where money things live. Delight is earned, not ambient: celebrations (confetti takeover, piggy pop, fireworks) fire only in response to a completed save, then get out of the way.
keyCharacteristics: Two fully authored themes — Flamingo Daylight and Neon Night Swim — swapped by a single data-theme attribute on the phone screen; components reference only tokens, never raw hex.
One sacred card geometry: 482px, five fixed grid slots, in every state.
A four-accent "crayon box" (guava / tangerine / sunshine / surf) where each color has a real job.
Bricolage Grotesque 800 shouts, Rubik speaks; drawn 1.8-stroke icons.
Motion is spring-based (framer-motion) with authored reduced-motion equivalents for everything.
The demo shell is deliberately outside the world: a 393×852 phone frame on an always-black stage.

rules.name: The Crayon Box Rule
rules.body: Four accents, four jobs: guava acts, surf confirms, sunshine-and-tangerine embody the sun gesture, palm only parties. Never swap their roles, and never introduce a fifth accent.

rules.name: The Re-Ink Rule
rules.body: Components reference only --token custom properties from tokens.css; both themes come for free. A raw hex in a component file is a bug (the only exceptions in code today are text-on-guava #2a0a18, piggy detail inks #3d0f22/#2a0a18, and the demo shell, which lives outside the themed world).

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: If it celebrates, names, or counts money, it is Bricolage 800 with negative tracking. Everything that explains or operates is Rubik. Never use Bricolage below weight 800 or for body copy.

rules.name: The Honest Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every money amount and date renders in tabular numerals; big figures are dark ink on the card surface, never on a saturated fill.

rules.name: The Five-Slot Rule
rules.body: No state of the save card may change the card's 482px height, its five grid rows, or which slot an element type lives in. New states compose within the slots.

rules.name: The Thumb-Reach Rule (ADA 44px)
rules.body: Every interactive target is at least 44×44px: chips, fields, and emoji buttons are 48px; pills are 64px; smaller visual affordances claim a 44px hit area via min-height/negative margins.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: No neutral-gray shadows anywhere. Daylight shadows carry sea-teal; glow shadows carry the color of the thing casting them (orange thumb, guava CTA, guava/pink active dot).

rules.name: The Sacred Footprint Rule
rules.body: The swipe pill and the CTA pill occupy the exact same 64px capsule footprint in the card's action slot. Whatever the state, the money action is one thumb-reach away in the same place.

rules.name: The Bleed-and-Link Rule
rules.body: Preset options are edge-bleeding, left-aligned, non-wrapping chip swipe-rows; the custom/DIY affordance is always an underlined link below the row, never a chip in it.

dos: Do render every save-card state through the fixed 482px five-slot grid (26px / minmax(20px,auto) / 1fr / 48px / 64px, 12px gap) — compose within slots, never restructure them.
Do style exclusively through tokens.css custom properties so both Flamingo Daylight and Neon Night Swim stay complete; add any new color to both themes at once.
Do give every interactive target a ≥44px hit area, using negative-margin expansion when the visual element is smaller (see .savecard__edit).
Do read celebration colors from --confetti-colors / --firework-colors at runtime; keep light-mode fireworks to the saturated-only palette.
Do provide a reduced-motion equivalent for every animation: particles off, sheets fade, springs become instant, chevrons hold at 0.7 opacity, celebration holds shorten.
Do draw new icons on the 24-unit grid at 1.8 stroke with round caps, using currentColor.
Do set tabular-nums on anything numeric users will compare (amounts, balances, dates).
donts: Don't move, resize, or hide the swipe pill in any active-goal state — the gesture is sacred and lives only in the 64px action slot.
Don't use neutral-gray shadows or pure #ffffff/#000000 surfaces inside the phone; daylight shadows are sea-teal-tinted, the card is warm white #fffdf8.
Don't hardcode palette hex in components — the piggy, canvas effects, and every control read tokens so dark mode re-inks for free.
Don't wrap chip rows or center them; they bleed off-screen and scroll. Don't put the "add my own" affordance inside the row.
Don't put large money figures on saturated fills, use Bricolage below weight 800, or introduce a fifth accent color.
Don't theme the stage or phone bezel — the page around the screen is always black; only .phone__screen carries data-theme.
